credits_text: Written and Directed by James O'Barr. Starring: Giancarlo Esposito, Thomas Haden Church, Kate Hudson, Michael Madsen, Andrea Riseborough, Alex Pettyfer, Timothy Olyphant, Topher Grace, Olivia Wilde, and Noah Segan.
moderation_notes: Contains mild violent imagery and a monstrous creature.
description: A group of people stands in front of a dark house under a stormy sky, with a monstrous figure looming above them.
